notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
Hello, 
 We are happy to announce that Lost Home: Battle of Island is now Release and You can now buy it.
 The Game is in Early Access state so expect bugs. We are working on it and hope to make it better in future updates.

notes.title: Little Mistake in the Steam Store Listing
notes.notes:
Hello, 
  There was a little mistake in our store listing  Which I have to admit that It's really something. I shouldn't have missed it.
 The Title of the game is "Lost Home" now somehow I have missed that the title for the Steam Store listing is showing the Game title as "Last Home".

However. I just fixed it. There will be Updates about the game posted soon.
